content.text:
Catalog search now ignores accents in the query, titles and authors, so `garcia marquez` finds García Márquez. All 61 tests pass, including a new one for this.

The fix is in `normaliseText` in `lib/helpers/text.js`. It now strips accent marks before lower-casing. Only search uses that function. The marks have to go before the step that turns punctuation into spaces, otherwise `é` would split a word in two.

The new test in `test/catalog.test.js` covers an accented query (`GARCÍA MÁRQUEZ`) and an unaccented one (`garcia marquez`) against accented text. It also covers `ñ` (`anos soledad` finds `años`) and an author typed with a combining accent (`Jose\u0301`).

Letters that aren't a base letter plus an accent, such as `ø`, `ł` and `ß`, are still not folded, so `Soren` won't match `Søren`. I left that alone because you only asked about accents.

I haven't committed anything.
